traceMetadata.stage: Stage 23: Resilient Autonomous Operations & Recovery Control
traceMetadata.phase: Phase 10: Governed Recovery Integration & Operational-Truth Feedback

scenarios.name: empirical truth takes precedence over inferred failure
scenarios.description: Operation reported failure or network disruption, but Stage 22 operationalTruth confirms SUCCEEDED remotely. Stage 23 immediately emits NO_RECOVERY_REQUIRED with CONFIRMED status.

scenarios.name: absent external confirmation mandates reconciliation barrier
scenarios.description: Post-dispatch timeout occurred; external confirmation is absent. Epistemic status is UNKNOWN. System blocks blind retry and routes to RECONCILE.

scenarios.name: Stage 20 active policy DENY produces ABORT
scenarios.description: Active snapshot contains critical containment policy evaluating to DENY. Recovery control plane enforces policy priority and halts with ABORT.

scenarios.name: Stage 20 active policy REQUIRE_APPROVAL produces REQUIRE_APPROVAL
scenarios.description: Active policy mandates human operator review prior to recovery action. Recovery control plane transitions outcome to REQUIRE_APPROVAL.

scenarios.name: Stage 20 active policy PAUSE produces PAUSE
scenarios.description: Active policy declares maintenance freeze. Recovery control plane pauses recovery progression.

scenarios.name: Stage 20 policy priority conflict resolution
scenarios.description: Low-priority ALLOW policy conflicts with high-priority SYSTEM_SAFETY DENY policy. Precedence engine resolves to DENY, yielding ABORT.

scenarios.name: Stage 21 policy snapshot drift detection
scenarios.description: Request specifies an obsolete snapshot ID or mismatched registry version. Control plane detects policy drift and fails closed to REQUIRE_APPROVAL.

scenarios.name: Stage 21 missing connector permission
scenarios.description: Requested action involves an unavailable connector or missing Stage 16 grant. Authority intersection detects MISSING_PERMISSION and fails closed to REQUIRE_APPROVAL.

scenarios.name: Stage 21 valid operator approval token execution
scenarios.description: Valid non-human-spoofed operator approval token provided within 5-minute TTL. Authorizes transient retry on idempotent action.

scenarios.name: hostile input defense: learning signal cannot assume authority
scenarios.description: Adversarial payload injects learningSignal and memoryFact claiming bypass authority. Control plane detects non-authoritative signal and blocks execution.

scenarios.name: Stage 22 canonical audit logging
scenarios.description: Recovery control decision creates a canonical OperationalAuditEvent with eventType GOVERNANCE_DECIDED, sourceSystem stage23_recovery_control, and causal links.

scenarios.name: Stage 22 causal graph and operation trace lineage
scenarios.description: Operation trace and causal DAG reconstructed via Stage 22 services verify the presence of GOVERNANCE_DECISION node in execution lineage.
